CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commercial_brand_monthly_v38(p_menu text DEFAULT 'dash'::text, p_stores bigint[] DEFAULT NULL::bigint[])
 RETURNS TABLE(store_id bigint, year integer, month integer, brand text, sales numeric, qty numeric, rows_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET statement_timeout TO '55s'
AS $function$
declare ids bigint[];
begin
 if p_menu<>all(array['dash','sales','h2h','brand','top','item','program','mkt','pdca']) then raise exception 'Menu sumber brand tidak valid' using errcode='42501';end if;
 ids:=public.commercial_scope_v38(p_menu,p_stores);
 return query
 with sku_map as (
  select m.store_id,nullif(btrim(m.sku),'') as sku,
   case when count(distinct upper(btrim(m.brand)))=1 then max(upper(btrim(m.brand))) end as brand
  from public.moka_item_brand_v43 m where nullif(btrim(m.sku),'') is not null group by 1,2
 ),name_map as (
  select m.store_id,upper(btrim(m.item_name)) as item,
   case when count(distinct upper(btrim(m.brand)))=1 then max(upper(btrim(m.brand))) end as brand
  from public.moka_item_brand_v43 m group by 1,2
 ),resolved as (
  select i.*,coalesce(k.brand,n.brand) as source_brand
  from public.item_sales i left join sku_map k on k.store_id=i.store_id and k.sku=nullif(btrim(i.sku),'')
   left join name_map n on n.store_id=i.store_id and n.item=upper(btrim(i.item_name))
  where ids is null or i.store_id=any(ids)
 ),classified as (
  select r.*,case regexp_replace(coalesce(r.source_brand,''),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g')
   when 'MAMU' then 'MAMU' when 'MYNO' then 'MYNO' when 'TIGALAPAN' then 'TIGALAPAN' when 'TIGALAPANKAOS' then 'TIGALAPAN' when 'DEFECT' then 'DEFECT' else null end as b
  from resolved r
 )select c.store_id::bigint,c.year::integer,c.month::integer,c.b,sum(c.net_sales)::numeric,sum(c.item_sold-c.item_refunded)::numeric,count(*)
 from classified c group by c.store_id,c.year,c.month,c.b;
end $function$

 RETURNS TABLE(bucket text, customers bigint, net numeric, sort integer)
 LANGUAGE sql

AS $function$
  with c as (

    group by customer_key

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commercial_customer_stats_v1(p_from date, p_to date, p_stores bigint[] DEFAULT NULL::bigint[])
 RETURNS TABLE(customers bigint, repeat_customers bigint, b2b_customers bigint, member_trx bigint, member_net numeric, walkin_trx bigint, walkin_net numeric, new_customers bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with c as (
    select customer_key, bool_or(customer_name ~* '^\s*MK[- ]?0?\d') b2b,
           count(distinct sale_date) visits, sum(trx) trx, sum(net) net
    from moka_customer_daily
    where sale_date between p_from and p_to and (p_stores is null or store_id = any(p_stores))
    group by customer_key
  ), firsts as (
    select customer_key, min(sale_date) first_seen from moka_customer_daily
    where (p_stores is null or store_id = any(p_stores)) group by customer_key
  ), w as (
    select coalesce(sum(trx),0)::bigint trx, coalesce(sum(net),0) net from moka_walkin_daily
    where sale_date between p_from and p_to and (p_stores is null or store_id = any(p_stores))
  )
  select count(*)::bigint, count(*) filter (where visits > 1)::bigint, count(*) filter (where b2b)::bigint,
         coalesce(sum(trx),0)::bigint, coalesce(sum(net),0), (select trx from w), (select net from w),
         (select count(*) from firsts f join c using (customer_key) where f.first_seen between p_from and p_to)::bigint
  from c
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commercial_customers_v1(p_from date, p_to date, p_stores bigint[] DEFAULT NULL::bigint[], p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 200)
 RETURNS TABLE(customer_key text, customer_name text, phone_last4 text, stores text, visits bigint, trx bigint, net numeric, items numeric, first_date date, last_date date, is_b2b boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select c.customer_key,
         max(c.customer_name), max(c.phone_last4),
         string_agg(distinct s.name, ', '),
         count(distinct c.sale_date)::bigint, sum(c.trx)::bigint, sum(c.net), sum(c.items),
         min(c.sale_date), max(c.sale_date),
         bool_or(c.customer_name ~* '^\s*MK[- ]?0?\d')
  from moka_customer_daily c
  left join stores s on s.id = c.store_id
  where c.sale_date between p_from and p_to
    and (p_stores is null or c.store_id = any(p_stores))
    and (p_query is null or p_query = '' or c.customer_name ilike '%'||p_query||'%' or c.phone_last4 = p_query)
  group by c.customer_key
  order by sum(c.net) desc
  limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 200), 2000))
$function$

AS $function$
 WITH r AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM public.commercial_item_rows_v1(p_year,p_m1,p_m2,p_stores,p_brands,p_categories,p_exclude)),
 totals AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(item_sold),0) sold,COALESCE(SUM(item_refunded),0) refunded,COALESCE(SUM(net_sales),0) net_sales,
 COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(sku,''),item_name)) sku_count,COUNT(*) row_count FROM r),

 GROUP BY item_name,item_variant_name,COALESCE(NULLIF(category,''),category_name,'(Tanpa kategori)'),sku),
 top_rows AS (SELECT * FROM grouped ORDER BY net_sales DESC,item_name,item_variant_name,sku LIMIT 300)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('totals',(SELECT to_jsonb(t) FROM totals t),'top',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.net_sales DESC,t.item_name,t.item_variant_name,t.sku) FROM top_rows t),'[]'::jsonb));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commercial_item_rollup_v1(p_year integer, p_m1 integer, p_m2 integer, p_stores integer[], p_brands text[], p_categories text[], p_exclude text[], p_dim text, p_limit integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(k text, qty numeric, refunded numeric, sales numeric, n_stores bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 WITH r AS (SELECT i.*,s.name store_name FROM public.commercial_item_rows_v1(p_year,p_m1,p_m2,p_stores,p_brands,p_categories,p_exclude) i LEFT JOIN public.stores s ON s.id=i.store_id),
 dimensions AS (SELECT CASE p_dim
 WHEN 'brand' THEN UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(brand),''),'LAINNYA'))
 WHEN 'category' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(category,''),category_name,'(Tanpa kategori)')
 WHEN 'store' THEN COALESCE(store_name,store_id::text)
 WHEN 'size' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(size,''),'(Tanpa size)')
 WHEN 'color' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(warna,''),'(Tanpa warna)')
 WHEN 'product' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(product,''),item_name)
 ELSE item_name END label,store_id,item_sold,item_refunded,net_sales FROM r)
 SELECT label::text,COALESCE(SUM(item_sold-item_refunded),0)::numeric,COALESCE(SUM(item_refunded),0)::numeric,COALESCE(SUM(net_sales),0)::numeric,COUNT(DISTINCT store_id)
 FROM dimensions GROUP BY label ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(net_sales),0) DESC,label LIMIT GREATEST(1,LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit,300),10000));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commercial_item_rows_v1(p_year integer, p_m1 integer, p_m2 integer, p_stores integer[], p_brands text[], p_categories text[], p_exclude text[])
 RETURNS SETOF item_sales
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT i.* FROM public.item_sales i
 WHERE i.year=p_year AND i.month BETWEEN p_m1 AND p_m2
 AND (p_stores IS NULL OR i.store_id=ANY(p_stores))
 AND (COALESCE(cardinality(p_brands),0)=0 OR UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(i.brand),''),'LAINNYA'))=ANY(p_brands))
 AND (COALESCE(cardinality(p_categories),0)=0 OR COALESCE(NULLIF(i.category,''),i.category_name,'(Tanpa kategori)')=ANY(p_categories))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(COALESCE(p_exclude,ARRAY[]::text[])) ex WHERE ex<>'' AND STRPOS(UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(i.category,''),i.category_name,'')),UPPER(ex))>0);
$function$

functions.args: p_year integer, p_m1 integer, p_d1 integer, p_m2 integer, p_d2 integer, p_stores bigint[], p_align boolean, p_compare integer, p_customers text[], p_kind text, p_query text, p_rank_year integer, p_limit integer, p_since_from date, p_since_to date, p_cities text[]
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commercial_member_items_v51(p_year integer, p_m1 integer, p_d1 integer, p_m2 integer, p_d2 integer, p_stores bigint[] DEFAULT NULL::bigint[], p_align boolean DEFAULT true, p_compare integer DEFAULT 3, p_customers text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_kind text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_rank_year integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_since_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_since_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_cities text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET statement_timeout TO '55s'
AS $function$
declare
  ids bigint[]; result jsonb; today date := (now() at time zone 'Asia/Makassar')::date;
  y3 integer := p_year; y2 integer := p_year - 1; y1 integer; ry integer; sel text[]; q text;
begin
  ids := public.commercial_scope_v38('members', p_stores);
  perform public.commercial_pin_session_v1();
  if p_year not between 2002 and 2099 or p_m1 not between 1 and 12 or p_m2 not between 1 and 12
     or p_d1 not between 1 and 31 or p_d2 not between 1 and 31 or (p_m1, p_d1) > (p_m2, p_d2)
     or coalesce(p_compare, 3) not in (2, 3) or p_limit not between 1 and 200
     or coalesce(array_length(p_customers, 1), 0) > 200 or p_kind not in ('all', 'b2b', 'retail') then
    raise exception 'Parameter item Member tidak valid';
  end if;
  y1 := case when coalesce(p_compare, 3) = 3 then y3 - 2 end;
  ry := coalesce(p_rank_year, y3);
  sel := case when coalesce(array_length(p_customers, 1), 0) > 0 then p_customers end;
  q := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_query, '')), '');

  with scope as (select id from stores where ids is null or id = any(ids)),
  base as (
    select y,
      make_date(y, p_m1, least(p_d1, extract(day from (make_date(y, p_m1, 1) + interval '1 month - 1 day'))::integer)) as a,
      make_date(y, p_m2, least(p_d2, extract(day from (make_date(y, p_m2, 1) + interval '1 month - 1 day'))::integer)) as full_b
    from (select distinct y from unnest(array[y1, y2, y3]) y where y is not null) t
  ),
  cap as (select least((select full_b from base where y = y3), today - 1) as capb,
                 least((select full_b from base where y = y3), today - 1) < (select full_b from base where y = y3) as capped),
  periods as (
    select b.y, b.a,
      case when c.capped and (b.y = y3 or p_align)
        then make_date(b.y, extract(month from c.capb)::integer,
               least(extract(day from c.capb)::integer,
                     extract(day from (make_date(b.y, extract(month from c.capb)::integer, 1) + interval '1 month - 1 day'))::integer))
        else b.full_b end as b
    from base b cross join cap c
  ),
  names as (
    select distinct on (customer_key) customer_key, customer_name
    from commercial_customer_daily_v47 d join scope s on s.id = d.store_id
    where (sel is null or d.customer_key = any(sel)) and (p_kind <> 'all' or sel is not null)
    order by customer_key, sale_date desc
  ),
  lines as (
    select i.customer_key, p.y, public.commercial_item_group_v51(i.item_name) as grp,
           max(i.category_name) as category, sum(i.qty) as qty, sum(i.net) as net, count(distinct i.transaction_id) as trx
    from moka_member_items_v51 i
    join scope s on s.id = i.store_id
    join periods p on i.sale_date between p.a and p.b
    where (sel is null or i.customer_key = any(sel))
      and i.net <> 0  -- baris gratis/kemasan (mis. PLASTIK OPP Rp0) tidak dihitung sebagai item dibeli
    group by 1, 2, 3
  ),
  kept as (
    select l.* from lines l left join names n using (customer_key)
    left join commercial_member_profiles_v47 pr on pr.customer_key = l.customer_key
    where (p_kind = 'all'
           or (p_kind = 'b2b' and coalesce(n.customer_name, pr.name, '') ~* '^\s*MK[ ._-]*[0-9]')
           or (p_kind = 'retail' and coalesce(n.customer_name, pr.name, '') !~* '^\s*MK[ ._-]*[0-9]'))
      and (q is null or l.grp ilike '%' || q || '%' or coalesce(l.category, '') ilike '%' || q || '%')
      and (p_since_from is null or pr.cust_since >= date_trunc('month', p_since_from)::date)
      and (p_since_to is null or pr.cust_since < (date_trunc('month', p_since_to) + interval '1 month')::date)
      and (coalesce(array_length(p_cities, 1), 0) = 0 or public.commercial_city_key_v51(pr.city) = any(select public.commercial_city_key_v51(c) from unnest(p_cities) c))
  ),
  groups as (
    select grp, max(category) as category,
      jsonb_object_agg(y::text, jsonb_build_object('qty', qty, 'net', net, 'buyers', buyers, 'trx', trx)) as years,
      sum(net) filter (where y = ry) as rk
    from (select grp, y, max(category) category, sum(qty) qty, sum(net) net, count(distinct customer_key) filter (where qty > 0) buyers, sum(trx) trx
          from kept group by 1, 2) g
    group by grp
  ),
  per_member as (
    select k.customer_key, coalesce(n.customer_name, pr.name, k.customer_key) as name, k.grp, max(k.category) as category,
      jsonb_object_agg(k.y::text, jsonb_build_object('qty', k.qty, 'net', k.net, 'trx', k.trx)) as years,
      sum(k.net) filter (where k.y = ry) as rk, sum(k.net) as total
    from kept k left join names n using (customer_key) left join commercial_member_profiles_v47 pr on pr.customer_key = k.customer_key
    where sel is not null
    group by 1, 2, 3
  ),
  coverage as (
    select p.y, min(i.sale_date) as first_item_date, count(i.transaction_id) as lines
    from periods p left join moka_member_items_v51 i on i.sale_date between p.a and p.b and i.store_id in (select id from scope)
    group by p.y
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'schema', 51,
    'years', case when y1 is null then jsonb_build_array(y2, y3) else jsonb_build_array(y1, y2, y3) end,
    'rank_year', ry,
    'periods', (select jsonb_object_agg(y::text, jsonb_build_object('from', a, 'to', b)) from periods),
    'coverage', (select jsonb_object_agg(y::text, jsonb_build_object('lines', lines, 'first', first_item_date)) from coverage),
    'total_groups', (select count(*) from groups),
    'totals', coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(y::text, jsonb_build_object('qty', qty, 'net', net, 'buyers', buyers))
                        from (select y, sum(qty) qty, sum(net) net, count(distinct customer_key) filter (where qty > 0) buyers from kept group by y) t), '{}'),
    'groups', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g) order by g.rk desc nulls last, g.grp)
                        from (select * from groups order by rk desc nulls last, grp limit p_limit) g), '[]'),
    'members', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) order by m.name, m.rk desc nulls last, m.total desc)
                         from (select *, row_number() over (partition by customer_key order by rk desc nulls last, total desc) rn from per_member) m
                         where m.rn <= 30), '[]')
  ) into result;
  return result;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commercial_member_receipt_items_v51(p_customer text, p_from date, p_to date, p_stores bigint[] DEFAULT NULL::bigint[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET statement_timeout TO '20s'
AS $function$
declare ids bigint[]; result jsonb;
begin
  ids := public.commercial_scope_v38('members', p_stores);
  perform public.commercial_pin_session_v1();
  if nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_customer, '')), '') is null or p_from is null or p_to is null or p_from > p_to or p_to - p_from > 1100 then
    raise exception 'Parameter nota Member tidak valid';
  end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(transaction_id, jsonb_build_object('qty', qty, 'items', items)), '{}') into result from (
    select t.transaction_id::text as transaction_id, sum(t.qty) as qty,
           string_agg(t.grp || ' ×' || trim(to_char(t.qty, 'FM999999990.##')), ' · ' order by abs(t.net) desc) as items
    from (select i.transaction_id, public.commercial_item_group_v51(i.item_name) as grp, sum(i.qty) as qty, sum(i.net) as net
          from moka_member_items_v51 i
          where i.customer_key = p_customer and i.sale_date between p_from and p_to and (ids is null or i.store_id = any(ids)) and i.net <> 0
          group by 1, 2) t
    group by 1) x;
  return result;
end
$function$

functions.args: p_years integer[], p_m1 integer, p_d1 integer, p_m2 integer, p_d2 integer, p_stores bigint[], p_query text, p_kind text, p_sort text, p_limit integer, p_offset integer, p_rank integer, p_align boolean, p_rank_year integer, p_compare integer, p_customers text[], p_since_from date, p_since_to date, p_cities text[]
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commercial_member_sssg_v51(p_years integer[], p_m1 integer, p_d1 integer, p_m2 integer, p_d2 integer, p_stores bigint[] DEFAULT NULL::bigint[], p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_kind text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'top'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_rank integer DEFAULT 10, p_align boolean DEFAULT true, p_rank_year integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_compare integer DEFAULT 3, p_customers text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_since_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_since_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_cities text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET statement_timeout TO '55s'
AS $function$
declare
  ids bigint[]; actor jsonb; cfg jsonb; pii boolean; result jsonb;
  today date := (now() at time zone 'Asia/Makassar')::date;
  y3 integer; y2 integer; y1 integer; q text; ry integer; sel text[];
begin
  ids := public.commercial_scope_v38('members', p_stores);
  actor := public.commercial_pin_session_v1();
  select value::jsonb into cfg from app_settings where key = 'kpi_access_v28';
  if jsonb_typeof(cfg) = 'string' then cfg := (cfg #>> '{}')::jsonb; end if;
  pii := actor->>'role' = 'master' or coalesce((cfg->'users'->(actor->>'id')->>'customer_pii')::boolean, false);

  if p_years is null or coalesce(array_length(p_years, 1), 0) not between 1 and 3
     or exists (select 1 from unnest(p_years) y where y not between 2002 and 2099)
     or p_m1 not between 1 and 12 or p_m2 not between 1 and 12 or p_d1 not between 1 and 31 or p_d2 not between 1 and 31
     or (p_m1, p_d1) > (p_m2, p_d2) or p_limit not between 1 and 200 or p_offset < 0 or p_rank not between 1 and 50
     or coalesce(p_compare, 3) not in (2, 3) or coalesce(array_length(p_customers, 1), 0) > 200
     or p_kind not in ('all', 'b2b', 'retail') or p_sort not in ('top', 'low', 'name', 'growth', 'decline', 'last') then
    raise exception 'Parameter SSSG Member tidak valid';
  end if;
  y3 := (select max(y) from unnest(p_years) y); y2 := y3 - 1;
  -- Mode 2 tahun: hanya y2 & y3 yang dihitung (y1 tidak dibaca sama sekali → hemat database).
  y1 := case when coalesce(p_compare, 3) = 3 then y3 - 2 else null end;
  ry := coalesce(p_rank_year, y3);
  if ry not in (y3, y2) and (y1 is null or ry <> y1) then raise exception 'Tahun acuan Top/Low harus salah satu kolom tahun'; end if;
  sel := case when coalesce(array_length(p_customers, 1), 0) > 0 then p_customers end;
  q := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_query, '')), '');

  with scope as (select id, name from stores where ids is null or id = any(ids)),
  -- Cut-off sama dengan SSSG sales: tahun berjalan s.d. kemarin; tahun pembanding dipotong
  -- pada tanggal yang sama (p_align) agar perbandingan per cut-off setara.
  base as (
    select y,
      make_date(y, p_m1, least(p_d1, extract(day from (make_date(y, p_m1, 1) + interval '1 month - 1 day'))::integer)) as a,
      make_date(y, p_m2, least(p_d2, extract(day from (make_date(y, p_m2, 1) + interval '1 month - 1 day'))::integer)) as full_b
    from (select distinct y from unnest(array[y1, y2, y3]) y where y is not null) t
  ),
  cap as (select least((select full_b from base where y = y3), today - 1) as capb,
                 least((select full_b from base where y = y3), today - 1) < (select full_b from base where y = y3) as capped),
  periods2 as (
    select b.y, b.a,
      case when c.capped and (b.y = y3 or p_align)
        then make_date(b.y, extract(month from c.capb)::integer,
               least(extract(day from c.capb)::integer,
                     extract(day from (make_date(b.y, extract(month from c.capb)::integer, 1) + interval '1 month - 1 day'))::integer))
        else b.full_b end as b
    from base b cross join cap c
  ),
  coverage as (
    select p.y, p.a, p.b, ((select count(*) from scope) * greatest(0, p.b - p.a + 1))::bigint as expected,
      (select count(*) from commercial_member_complete_v47 c join scope s on s.id = c.store_id where c.sale_date between p.a and p.b)::bigint as covered
    from periods2 p
  ),
  facts as (
    select d.customer_key, d.store_id, p.y, sum(d.net) as net, sum(d.trx)::bigint as trx,
           max(d.sale_date) filter (where d.trx > 0) as last_visit,
           (array_agg(d.customer_name order by d.sale_date desc) filter (where nullif(btrim(d.customer_name), '') is not null))[1] as name
    from commercial_customer_daily_v47 d
    join scope s on s.id = d.store_id
    join periods2 p on d.sale_date between p.a and p.b
    where nullif(btrim(d.customer_key), '') is not null
      and (sel is null or d.customer_key = any(sel))
    group by 1, 2, 3
  ),
  cust as (
    select f.customer_key,
      (array_agg(f.name order by f.y desc, f.last_visit desc nulls last) filter (where f.name is not null))[1] as name,
      sum(f.net) filter (where f.y = y3) as n3, sum(f.net) filter (where f.y = y2) as n2, sum(f.net) filter (where f.y = y1) as n1,
      sum(f.trx) filter (where f.y = y3) as t3, sum(f.trx) filter (where f.y = y2) as t2,
      max(f.last_visit) as last_visit,
      sum(f.net) filter (where f.y = ry) as rk,
      jsonb_object_agg(f.store_id::text || ':' || f.y::text, f.net) as per_store
    from facts f group by f.customer_key
  ),
  enriched as (
    select c.*, coalesce(c.name, p.name, '(Tanpa nama)') as label, p.cust_since, p.city,
      case when pii then p.phone end as phone,
      coalesce(c.name, p.name, '') ~* '^\s*MK[ ._-]*[0-9]' as b2b
    from cust c left join commercial_member_profiles_v47 p on p.customer_key = c.customer_key
  ),
  filtered as (
    select * from enriched e
    where (p_kind = 'all' or (p_kind = 'b2b' and e.b2b) or (p_kind = 'retail' and not e.b2b))
      and (q is null or e.label ilike '%' || q || '%' or e.customer_key ilike '%' || q || '%'
           or (pii and coalesce(e.phone, '') ilike '%' || q || '%'))
      and (p_since_from is null or e.cust_since >= date_trunc('month', p_since_from)::date)
      and (p_since_to is null or e.cust_since < (date_trunc('month', p_since_to) + interval '1 month')::date)
      and (coalesce(array_length(p_cities, 1), 0) = 0 or public.commercial_city_key_v51(e.city) = any(select public.commercial_city_key_v51(c) from unnest(p_cities) c))
  ),
  -- Member baru per bulan (berdasar "member sejak" di Customer List Moka)
  nb_range as (
    select date_trunc('month', coalesce(p_since_from, (select a from periods2 where y = y3)))::date as f,
           (date_trunc('month', coalesce(p_since_to, (select b from periods2 where y = y3))) + interval '1 month')::date as t
  ),
  registered as (
    select date_trunc('month', p.cust_since)::date as mon, p.customer_key,
           coalesce(p.name, '') ~* '^\s*MK[ ._-]*[0-9]' as b2b
    from commercial_member_profiles_v47 p, nb_range r
    where p.cust_since >= r.f and p.cust_since < r.t
      and (sel is null or p.customer_key = any(sel))
      and (coalesce(array_length(p_cities, 1), 0) = 0 or public.commercial_city_key_v51(p.city) = any(select public.commercial_city_key_v51(c) from unnest(p_cities) c))
      and (ids is null or exists (select 1 from commercial_customer_daily_v47 d where d.customer_key = p.customer_key and d.store_id = any(ids)))
  ),
  new_by_month as (
    select g.mon, count(*) as registered,
      count(*) filter (where e.n3 is not null) as active,
      sum(e.n3) as net, sum(e.t3)::bigint as trx
    from registered g left join enriched e using (customer_key)
    where (p_kind = 'all' or (p_kind = 'b2b' and g.b2b) or (p_kind = 'retail' and not g.b2b))
    group by g.mon
  ),
  store_year as (
    select f.store_id, f.y, sum(f.net) as net, count(distinct f.customer_key) filter (where f.trx > 0) as customers, sum(f.trx)::bigint as trx
    from facts f join filtered x using (customer_key) group by 1, 2
  ),
  totals as (
    select f.y, sum(f.net) as net, sum(f.trx)::bigint as trx,
      count(distinct f.customer_key) filter (where f.trx > 0) as customers,
      count(distinct f.customer_key) filter (where f.net > 0) as buyers
    from facts f join filtered x using (customer_key) group by 1
  ),
  months as (
    select p.y, extract(month from d.sale_date)::integer as month, sum(d.net) as net,
      count(distinct d.customer_key) filter (where d.trx > 0) as customers, sum(d.trx)::bigint as trx
    from commercial_customer_daily_v47 d join scope s on s.id = d.store_id join periods2 p on d.sale_date between p.a and p.b
    join filtered x on x.customer_key = d.customer_key
    where (sel is null or d.customer_key = any(sel)) group by 1, 2
  ),
  ranked as (
    select f.*, row_number() over (order by
      case when p_sort = 'top' then coalesce(rk, -1e18) end desc,
      case when p_sort = 'low' then coalesce(rk, 1e18) end asc,
      case when p_sort = 'growth' then (coalesce(n3, 0) - coalesce(n2, 0)) end desc nulls last,
      case when p_sort = 'decline' then (coalesce(n3, 0) - coalesce(n2, 0)) end asc nulls last,
      case when p_sort = 'last' then last_visit end desc nulls last,
      label, customer_key) as ord
    from filtered f
  ),
  page as (select * from ranked where ord > p_offset and ord <= p_offset + p_limit),
  -- Pergerakan bulanan hanya untuk member di halaman ini (hemat egress): "tahun-bulan" → net.
  page_month as (
    select x.customer_key, jsonb_object_agg(x.y::text || '-' || lpad(x.m::text, 2, '0'), x.net) as per_month
    from (select d.customer_key, p.y, extract(month from d.sale_date)::integer as m, sum(d.net) as net
          from commercial_customer_daily_v47 d join scope s on s.id = d.store_id
          join periods2 p on d.sale_date between p.a and p.b
          where d.customer_key in (select customer_key from page)
          group by 1, 2, 3) x
    group by x.customer_key
  ),
  out_row as (
    select g.customer_key as key, g.label as name, g.b2b, g.cust_since as since, g.city, g.phone, g.last_visit,
      g.n1, g.n2, g.n3, g.t2, g.t3, g.rk, g.per_store, coalesce(pm.per_month, '{}'::jsonb) as per_month, g.ord
    from page g left join page_month pm using (customer_key)
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'schema', 51, 'years', case when y1 is null then jsonb_build_array(y2, y3) else jsonb_build_array(y1, y2, y3) end,
    'rank_year', ry, 'selected', coalesce(array_length(sel, 1), 0), 'pii_allowed', pii,
    'stores', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'name', name) order by name) from scope), '[]'),
    'periods', coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(y::text, jsonb_build_object('from', a, 'to', b, 'covered', covered, 'expected', expected,
                 'complete', expected > 0 and covered = expected)) from coverage), '{}'),
    'totals', coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(y::text, to_jsonb(t) - 'y') from totals t), '{}'),
    'store_year', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)) from store_year s), '[]'),
    'months', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) order by m.y, m.month) from months m), '[]'),
    'top', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) order by r.rk desc) from (
              select customer_key as key, label as name, b2b, cust_since as since, city, phone, last_visit, n1, n2, n3, t3, rk, per_store
              from filtered where rk is not null order by rk desc, label limit p_rank) r), '[]'),
    'low', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) order by r.rk asc) from (
              select customer_key as key, label as name, b2b, cust_since as since, city, phone, last_visit, n1, n2, n3, t3, rk, per_store
              from filtered where rk > 0 order by rk asc, label limit p_rank) r), '[]'),
    'total_rows', (select count(*) from filtered),
    'new_by_month', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('month', to_char(mon, 'YYYY-MM'), 'registered', registered, 'active', active, 'net', net, 'trx', trx) order by mon) from new_by_month), '[]'),
    'rows', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(o) - 'ord' order by o.ord) from out_row o), '[]')
  ) into result;
  return result;
end
$function$

functions.name: commercial_member_view_profile_v40
functions.args: p_year integer, p_compare integer, p_from text, p_to text, p_month integer, p_stores bigint[]
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commercial_member_view_profile_v40(p_year integer, p_compare integer, p_from text DEFAULT '01-01'::text, p_to text DEFAULT '12-31'::text, p_month integer DEFAULT 1, p_stores bigint[] DEFAULT NULL::bigint[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET statement_timeout TO '55s'
AS $function$
declare ids bigint[];result jsonb;asof date;actor jsonb;cfg jsonb;pii boolean;
begin
 ids:=public.commercial_scope_v38('members',p_stores);
 actor:=public.commercial_pin_session_v1();select value::jsonb into cfg from public.app_settings where key='kpi_access_v28';
 if jsonb_typeof(cfg)='string' then cfg:=(cfg#>>'{}')::jsonb;end if;
 pii:=actor->>'role'='master' or coalesce((cfg->'users'->(actor->>'id')->>'customer_pii')::boolean,false);
 if p_year not between 2002 and 2099 or p_compare not between 2000 and 2099 or p_compare>=p_year or p_month not between 1 and 12 or p_from !~ '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$' or p_to !~ '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$' or p_from>p_to then raise exception 'Tahun/rentang profiling tidak valid';end if;
 perform make_date(p_year,split_part(p_from,'-',1)::integer,split_part(p_from,'-',2)::integer);
 perform make_date(p_year,split_part(p_to,'-',1)::integer,split_part(p_to,'-',2)::integer);
 asof:=make_date(p_year,split_part(p_to,'-',1)::integer,least(split_part(p_to,'-',2)::integer,extract(day from(make_date(p_year,split_part(p_to,'-',1)::integer,1)+interval '1 month - 1 day'))::integer));
 with scope as(select id,name from stores where ids is null or id=any(ids)),ys as(select distinct unnest(array[p_year-2,p_year-1,p_year,p_compare]) as y),
 periods as(select y,
 make_date(y,split_part(p_from,'-',1)::integer,least(split_part(p_from,'-',2)::integer,extract(day from(make_date(y,split_part(p_from,'-',1)::integer,1)+interval '1 month - 1 day'))::integer)) as a,
 make_date(y,split_part(p_to,'-',1)::integer,least(split_part(p_to,'-',2)::integer,extract(day from(make_date(y,split_part(p_to,'-',1)::integer,1)+interval '1 month - 1 day'))::integer)) as b from ys),
 coverage as(select p.*,((select count(*) from scope)*(p.b-p.a+1))::bigint as expected,
 (select count(*) from commercial_member_complete_v47 c join scope s on s.id=c.store_id where c.sale_date between p.a and p.b) as covered from periods p),
 history as(select d.*,s.name as store from commercial_customer_daily_v47 d join scope s on s.id=d.store_id where d.sale_date<=asof and nullif(btrim(d.customer_key),'') is not null),
 customers as(select customer_key,(array_agg(customer_name order by sale_date desc) filter(where nullif(customer_name,'') is not null))[1] as name,
 min(sale_date) filter(where trx>0) as first_purchase,max(sale_date) filter(where trx>0) as last_visit,max(phone_last4) as last4,
 string_agg(distinct store,', ' order by store) as branches from history group by customer_key),
 values_by_year as(select d.customer_key,p.y,d.store_id,d.store,sum(d.net) as net,sum(d.trx)::bigint as trx,max(d.sale_date) filter(where d.trx>0) as last_visit
 from history d join periods p on d.sale_date between p.a and p.b group by 1,2,3,4),
 annual as(select customer_key,y,sum(net) as net from values_by_year group by 1,2),
 freqcoverage as(select count(*) as n from commercial_member_complete_v47 c join scope s on s.id=c.store_id where c.sale_date between greatest(make_date(p_year,p_month,1),(select a from periods where y=p_year)) and least((make_date(p_year,p_month,1)+interval '1 month - 1 day')::date,asof)),
 freq as(select customer_key,sum(trx)::bigint as trx from history where sale_date between greatest(make_date(p_year,p_month,1),(select a from periods where y=p_year)) and least((make_date(p_year,p_month,1)+interval '1 month - 1 day')::date,asof) group by 1),
 records as(select c.customer_key as key,c.customer_key as source_no,coalesce(c.name,'(Tanpa nama)') as name,c.branches as branch,
 c.last_visit as last,c.first_purchase,c.last4 as phone_last4,
 case when coalesce(c.name,'') ~* '^\s*MK[ ._-]*[0-9]' then 'B2B · MK' else 'Selain kode MK' end as category,
 null::text as status,p.cust_since as since,p.city,case when pii then p.phone end as phone,
 (select jsonb_object_agg(p.y::text,case when a.net is not null then a.net when p.covered=p.expected and p.expected>0 then 0 else null end) from coverage p left join annual a on a.customer_key=c.customer_key and a.y=p.y) as revenues
 from customers c left join public.moka_customers_v47 p on p.customer_key=c.customer_key),
 transactions as(select c.customer_key,case when (select n from freqcoverage)=(select count(*) from scope)*greatest(0,least((make_date(p_year,p_month,1)+interval '1 month - 1 day')::date,asof)-greatest(make_date(p_year,p_month,1),(select a from periods where y=p_year))+1) and (select count(*) from scope)>0 and least((make_date(p_year,p_month,1)+interval '1 month - 1 day')::date,asof)>=greatest(make_date(p_year,p_month,1),(select a from periods where y=p_year)) then coalesce(f.trx,0) else null end as trx from customers c left join freq f using(customer_key))
 select jsonb_build_object('schema',27,'source','customer_list_purchase_history_v47','year',p_year,'compare',p_compare,'asof',asof,'month',p_month,
 'stores',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)) from scope s),'[]'),
 'periods',coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(y::text,jsonb_build_object('year',y,'kind','actual','month',extract(month from b),'as_of',b,'date_from',a,'date_to',b,'covered',covered,'expected',expected,'complete',expected>0 and covered=expected)) from coverage),'{}'),
 'records',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) order by r.name,r.key) from records r),'[]'),
 'transactions',coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(customer_key,jsonb_build_object(p_year::text||'-'||lpad(p_month::text,2,'0'),trx)) from transactions),'{}'),
 'store_sales',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v)) from values_by_year v),'[]')) into result;
 return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commercial_program_item_catalog_v1(p_categories text[], p_exclude text[])
 RETURNS TABLE(category text, item_name text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(i.category,''),i.category_name,'(Tanpa kategori)') category,COALESCE(i.item_name,'(Tanpa nama)') item_name
 FROM public.item_sales i
 WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(i.category,''),i.category_name,'(Tanpa kategori)')=ANY(p_categories)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(COALESCE(p_exclude,ARRAY[]::text[])) ex WHERE ex<>'' AND STRPOS(UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(i.category,''),i.category_name,'')),UPPER(ex))>0)

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commercial_program_item_rollup_v1(p_year integer, p_m1 integer, p_m2 integer, p_stores integer[], p_brands text[], p_categories text[], p_exclude text[], p_items jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(category text, item_name text, qty numeric, refunded numeric, sales numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(i.category,''),i.category_name,'(Tanpa kategori)') category,COALESCE(i.item_name,'(Tanpa nama)') item_name,
 COALESCE(SUM(i.item_sold-i.item_refunded),0)::numeric qty,COALESCE(SUM(i.item_refunded),0)::numeric refunded,COALESCE(SUM(i.net_sales),0)::numeric sales
 FROM public.commercial_item_rows_v1(p_year,p_m1,p_m2,p_stores,p_brands,p_categories,p_exclude) i
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_to_recordset(COALESCE(p_items,'[]'::jsonb)) chosen(category text,item_name text)
 WHERE chosen.category=COALESCE(NULLIF(i.category,''),i.category_name,'(Tanpa kategori)') AND chosen.item_name=COALESCE(i.item_name,'(Tanpa nama)'))
 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(i.category,''),i.category_name,'(Tanpa kategori)'),COALESCE(i.item_name,'(Tanpa nama)')
 ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(i.net_sales),0) DESC,category,item_name LIMIT 10001;
$function$

 RETURNS TABLE(k text, qty numeric, refunded numeric, sales numeric, n_stores bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select case p_dim when 'product' then product when 'color' then coalesce(warna,'(Tanpa warna)')
         when 'size' then coalesce(size,'(Tanpa size)') when 'category' then coalesce(category,'-')
         when 'brand' then brand when 'store' then store_name else item_name end,
    sum(item_sold_real), sum(item_refunded), sum(net_sales), count(distinct store_id)
  from v_item_enriched
  where year=p_year and month between p_m1 and p_m2
    and (p_stores is null or store_id = any(p_stores))
    and (p_brand is null or brand=p_brand)
    and (p_exclude is null or not exists (select 1 from unnest(p_exclude) t where category ilike '%'||t||'%'))
  group by 1 order by 4 desc nulls last limit p_limit

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.item_rollup(p_dim text, p_year integer, p_m1 integer DEFAULT 1, p_m2 integer DEFAULT 12, p_stores bigint[] DEFAULT NULL::bigint[], p_brand text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_exclude text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_limit integer DEFAULT 300, p_category text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(k text, qty numeric, refunded numeric, sales numeric, n_stores bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select case p_dim when 'product' then product when 'color' then coalesce(warna,'(Tanpa warna)')
         when 'size' then coalesce(size,'(Tanpa size)') when 'category' then coalesce(category,'-')
         when 'brand' then brand when 'store' then store_name else item_name end,
    sum(item_sold_real), sum(item_refunded), sum(net_sales), count(distinct store_id)
  from v_item_enriched
  where year=p_year and month between p_m1 and p_m2
    and (p_stores is null or store_id = any(p_stores))
    and (p_brand is null or brand=p_brand)
    and (p_category is null or category=p_category)
    and (p_exclude is null or not exists (select 1 from unnest(p_exclude) t where category ilike '%'||t||'%'))
  group by 1 order by 4 desc nulls last limit p_limit
$function$

functions.name: rebuild_sales_actual
functions.args: p_year integer, p_month integer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rebuild_sales_actual(p_year integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_month integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
declare n int;
begin
  insert into sales_actual (store_id, year, month,
      sales_komersial, sales_user,
      sales_komersial_tigalapan, sales_user_tigalapan, sales_user_mamu, is_manual)
  select r.store_id, r.year, r.month,
      sum(case when m.keterangan = 'KOMERSIAL' then r.amount else 0 end),
      sum(case when m.keterangan = 'USER'      then r.amount else 0 end),
      sum(case when m.segmen = 'KOMERSIAL TIGALAPAN' then r.amount else 0 end),
      sum(case when m.segmen = 'USER TIGALAPAN'      then r.amount else 0 end),
      sum(case when m.segmen = 'USER MAMU'           then r.amount else 0 end),
      false
  from sales_type_raw r
  join sales_type_map m on upper(btrim(m.sales_type)) = upper(btrim(r.sales_type))
  where (p_year is null or r.year = p_year)
    and (p_month is null or r.month = p_month)
  group by r.store_id, r.year, r.month
  on conflict (store_id, year, month) do update set
      sales_komersial           = excluded.sales_komersial,
      sales_user                = excluded.sales_user,
      sales_komersial_tigalapan = excluded.sales_komersial_tigalapan,
      sales_user_tigalapan      = excluded.sales_user_tigalapan,
      sales_user_mamu           = excluded.sales_user_mamu,
      updated_at                = now()
  where sales_actual.is_manual = false;   -- input manual tidak ditimpa
  get diagnostics n = row_count;
  return n;
end $function$

functions.name: rebuild_transaksi_from_raw
functions.args: p_year integer, p_month integer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rebuild_transaksi_from_raw(p_year integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_month integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
declare n int;
begin
  insert into transaksi (store_id, year, month, jumlah_transaksi, nilai_transaksi)
  select r.store_id, r.year, r.month, sum(r.trx_count), sum(r.amount)
  from sales_type_raw r
  where (p_year is null or r.year = p_year) and (p_month is null or r.month = p_month)
  group by r.store_id, r.year, r.month
  on conflict (store_id, year, month) do update set
      jumlah_transaksi = excluded.jumlah_transaksi, nilai_transaksi = excluded.nilai_transaksi, updated_at = now()
  where not coalesce(transaksi.is_manual,false);
  get diagnostics n = row_count;
  return n;
end $function$

functions.name: recompute_item_enrich
functions.args: p_ids bigint[]
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recompute_item_enrich(p_ids bigint[] DEFAULT NULL::bigint[])
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  update item_sales i
  set category = coalesce(pm.category, i2.category_name),
      brand    = coalesce(pm.brand, cb.brand, 'LAINNYA'),
      product  = coalesce(pm.name, regexp_replace(i2.item_name, '\s+(PDK|PJG)\s+\S+$', '')),
      warna    = coalesce(nullif(pm.warna,''), nullif(trim(substring(i2.item_name, '^(.*?)\s+(\d{2}S|\+\s*RIB|WK\s+MYNO)(\s|$)')), '')),
      size     = nullif(substring(upper(trim(i2.item_name)), '\s(XS|S|M|L|XL|[2-9]XL|XXL|XXXL|\d{1,2}|ALL|FS)$'), '')
  from item_sales i2
  left join product_master pm on pm.item_name = i2.item_name
  left join category_brand cb on cb.category = i2.category_name
  where i.id = i2.id
    and (p_ids is null or i.id = any(p_ids));
end;
$function$

views.name: v_sales_dashboard
views.definition:
WITH per AS (
         SELECT targets.year,
            targets.month
           FROM targets
        UNION
         SELECT sales_actual.year,
            sales_actual.month
           FROM sales_actual
          GROUP BY sales_actual.year, sales_actual.month
        ), f AS (
         SELECT app_settings.value AS formula
           FROM app_settings
          WHERE app_settings.key = 'total_sales_formula'::text
        )
 SELECT st.id AS store_id,
    st.name AS store_name,
    st.brand,
    st.region,
    st.spv,
    d.year,
    d.month,
    COALESCE(s.sales_komersial, 0::numeric) AS sales_komersial,
    COALESCE(s.sales_user, 0::numeric) AS sales_user,
    COALESCE(s.sales_komersial_tigalapan, 0::numeric) AS sales_komersial_tigalapan,
    COALESCE(s.sales_user_tigalapan, 0::numeric) AS sales_user_tigalapan,
    COALESCE(s.sales_user_mamu, 0::numeric) AS sales_user_mamu,
    COALESCE(t.target_komersial, 0::numeric) AS target_komersial,
    COALESCE(t.target_user, 0::numeric) AS target_user,
    COALESCE(t.target_total, 0::numeric) AS target_total,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(( SELECT f.formula
               FROM f), 'KOM_PLUS_USER'::text) = 'SUM_ALL'::text THEN COALESCE(s.sales_komersial, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(s.sales_user, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(s.sales_komersial_tigalapan, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(s.sales_user_tigalapan, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(s.sales_user_mamu, 0::numeric)
            ELSE COALESCE(s.sales_komersial, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(s.sales_user, 0::numeric)
        END AS total_sales,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(t.target_komersial, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN COALESCE(s.sales_komersial, 0::numeric) / t.target_komersial
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS achiev_komersial,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(t.target_user, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN COALESCE(s.sales_user, 0::numeric) / t.target_user
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS achiev_user,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(t.target_total, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN (COALESCE(s.sales_komersial, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(s.sales_user, 0::numeric)) / t.target_total
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS achiev_total,
    COALESCE(s.sales_komersial, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(s.sales_user, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(t.target_total, 0::numeric) AS gap_sales
   FROM stores st
     CROSS JOIN per d
     LEFT JOIN sales_actual s ON s.store_id = st.id AND s.year = d.year AND s.month = d.month
     LEFT JOIN targets t ON t.store_id = st.id AND t.year = d.year AND t.month = d.month
  WHERE st.is_active;
